recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If current tooling behavior or documentation for the fixed metadata-resource version option needs verification or repair, handle that in the current IG Publisher/Maven repository rather than changing HL7/fhir core source.
issue_request: FHIR-12487 asked for IG Publisher support to set the version element on generated metadata resources to one fixed IG version and for ImplementationGuide guidance to make clear that this can be a useful way to manage change.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 10630, preserved as git commit 0323c0de1b30d652ff540a205eb5cde0eaad789c, which added fixed-business-version configuration handling and validation to the then-in-tree IG Publisher. No separate Jira-tagged ImplementationGuide source/narrative edit was found in that commit.
additional_context: The referenced Zulip thread converged on versioning all profiles with the IG and adding a publisher JSON setting to set metadata artifact versions. The in-tree IG Publisher was later removed from HL7/fhir in commit 56ceb0df08dd72381a4f98f1ea4ac5ea6d139a8b because it had moved to Maven. Current active core sources define ImplementationGuide.version and CanonicalResource.version as business/canonical versions and include Resource guidance on record, business, and FHIR versions.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. There is no current in-scope HL7/fhir source surface for the old IG Publisher option, and adding publisher-specific configuration text to the core resource definition would duplicate external tooling documentation rather than correct a current spec defect.
